item.title: Run Local Price History Backfill
item.description:
The local backfill script ingests historical price data from 2023-01-01 to the current date. The code filters S&P 500 by MIN_MARKET_CAP = 10_000_000_000, partitions prices by individual trading date, and writes a company info snapshot on the day the script runs.

The local backfill script does not write us_financials_raw.parquet. Financials are ingested via the daily ingestion pipeline; the transformation code includes appropriate fallback handlers.

Install Local Dependencies

# Create a dedicated virtual environment for local backfill.
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

# Install packages required by source imports.
pip install boto3 pandas requests yfinance pyarrow tqdm lxml

Preparation and Run Backfill

Step Action Technical Details
1 Create file backfill_raw_ingestion.py Use the full source code below
2 Verify BUCKET_NAME Must be stock-screener-raw-your-name
3 Set MAX_TICKERS_FOR_TEST Test with a small batch first; use None when running full execution
4 Keep credentials outside source code boto3 uses the AWS CLI profile/credential chain
5 Run Python script Script calls STS to verify identity before crawling 
# Run local backfill.
python backfill_raw_ingestion.py

item.title: Deploy Daily Ingestion via Glue Python Shell
item.description:
Daily Ingestion fetches the S&P 500 ticker list from Wikipedia, pulls market data from Yahoo Finance via yfinance, and writes three Raw datasets.

us_prices_raw.parquet
us_company_info.parquet
us_financials_raw.parquet

Unlike local backfill execution, this step creates an AWS Glue Python Shell Job and pastes source code directly into the Glue Script editor.

Prerequisites Before Job Creation

Step Action Technical Details
1 Verify Raw Bucket The active S3 bucket is stock-screener-raw-khanh
2 Verify IAM Role Role AWSGlueServiceRole-StockScreener must have write permissions to raw_us_market/*
3 Verify Internet access The Job must be able to call Wikipedia, Yahoo Finance, and PyPI to install additional packages
4 Prepare source code Copy the complete daily_ingestion.py code at the bottom of this page
5 Do not hardcode credentials boto3.client("s3") automatically uses temporary credentials supplied by the Glue Role

Architectural Principle – Direct Editor. Glue Studio allows creating a new Python Shell script and writing code directly in the Script editor. You do not need to manually upload the script file to S3. AWS Glue still manages the Script Location for the Job at the service layer, but no manual operations with a glue-scripts/ directory are required.
